Lenovo Legion 5 15IRX10 Gaming Laptop

Step into high-performance gaming with the Lenovo Legion 5 15IRX10. Powered by the 13th Gen Intel® Core™ i7-13650HX processor and NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 5070 Laptop GPU, it delivers powerful performance for modern AAA gaming, competitive esports, streaming, content creation and demanding workloads.

The NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 5070 Laptop GPU features 8GB GDDR7 graphics memory, a maximum TGP of 115W and support for NVIDIA DLSS 4, providing advanced AI-powered performance, realistic ray-traced graphics and smoother gameplay.

products.raw_description:
The LENOVO LOQ 15AHP9 is an AI-powered gaming laptop equipped with an AMD Ryzen 7 7445HS processor featuring 6 cores and 12 threads, paired with 16GB DDR5-5600 memory and an NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 6GB GDDR6 graphics card with a 95W TGP.

The 15.6-inch FHD IPS display delivers 1920 × 1080 resolution, 300-nit brightness, a 144Hz refresh rate, 100% sRGB color gamut, and G-SYNC support. Storage is provided by a 512GB PCIe 4.0 NVMe SSD, with two M.2 PCIe 4.0 slots available for storage expansion and two DDR5 SODIMM slots supporting up to 32GB of memory.

Connectivity includes three USB-A ports, USB-C with DisplayPort 1.4 and 65–100W Power Delivery, HDMI 2.1 with support up to 8K/60Hz, RJ-45 Ethernet, Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.2, and a 3.5mm audio combo jack. The laptop also features a 60Wh battery, white backlit English keyboard, 720p camera with E-shutter, and Nahimic-optimized stereo speakers. The LENOVO LOQ 15AHP9 is available for shoppers in Egypt at Compumarts.

products.raw_description:
مستند 


           ! CYBER-UP ادخل مستقبل الألعاب حيث تلتقي جماليات السايبربانك بأسلوب الخيال العلمي. تجهز بأحدث التقنيات التي تضعك في صدارة المنافسة. جهاز Cyborg 15 B13W بتصميمه المستقبلي المستوحى من الآليات، يعيد تعريف شكل وإحساس الحاسب المحمول المخصص للألعاب من الجيل التالي. 
       نحو الجيل التالي مع معالج يصل إلى Intel® Core™ i7 13620H  معالج Intel® Core™ i7 من الجيل الثالث عشر هنا. ببنية الأنوية الهجينة المحسنة التي تتكون من 6 أنوية أداء و 4 أنوية كفاءة، لتعدد مهام أفضل وتشغيل الألعاب المتطلبة.  10 أنوية تعزيز في الأداء يصل إلى 15%*  *الأداء مقارنة بالجيل السابق من معالج Intel® Core™ i7 12650H. تختلف المواصفات حسب الطراز.           حواسب GeForce RTX™ 50 Series المحمولة تغيير جذري في اللعبة  مدعومة بمعمارية NVIDIA Blackwell، تجلب وحدات معالجة الرسوميات GeForce RTX™ 50 Series للحواسب المحمولة قدرات تغير قواعد اللعبة للاعبين والمبدعين. مزودة بمستوى هائل من قوة الذكاء الاصطناعي، تتيح سلسلة RTX 50 تجارب جديدة ومستوى جديد من دقة الرسوميات. ضاعف الأداء مع NVIDIA DLSS 4، وولّد الصور بسرعة غير مسبوقة، وأطلق العنان لإبداعك مع NVIDIA Studio. كل ذلك في أنحف حواسب RTX محمولة وأطولها عمرًا، محسّنة بتقنية Max-Q.           سرعة فائقة. مرئيات استثنائية. مدعومة بالذكاء الاصطناعي.  NVIDIA DLSS هي مجموعة ثورية من تقنيات الـ neural rendering التي تستخدم الذكاء الاصطناعي لزيادة FPS وتقليل زمن الاستجابة وتحسين جودة الصورة. يقدم DLSS 4 ميزة Multi Frame Generation الجديدة وتحسينات Ray Reconstruction و Super Resolution، مدعومة بوحدات معالجة الرسوميات GeForce RTX 50 Series والجيل الخامس من أنوية Tensor.            أكثر ذكاءً الآن  استمتع بإنتاجية أكثر ذكاءً بفضل Copilot و MSI AI Engine لتعدد المهام بسلاسة. تتكيف أدوات الذكاء الاصطناعي المتقدمة هذه مع احتياجاتك، لتحسين الأداء وتبسيط سير العمل بلا عناء.           حركة سلسة وأنيقة  التقط كل حركة مع شاشة IPS-Level الحادة والسلسة بمعدل تحديث 144Hz. *اختياري. المواصفات الفعلية قد تختلف حسب التكوين.           تبريد ثوري لألعاب الجيل التالي  يتيح تصميم الأنابيب المشتركة الجديد بين CPU و GPU موازنة تبديد الحرارة في الوقت الفعلي بين CPU و GPU لتحسين الكفاءة. هذا، بالإضافة إلى معجون MSI الحراري الحصري، يضمن أقصى أداء أثناء الألعاب القاسية.           تألق بأسلوب الألعاب  تم تجهيز سلسلة Cyborg بلوحة مفاتيح 4-Zone RGB مع مفاتيح WASD المضيئة وأغطية مفاتيح مصممة خصيصًا. استمتع بالضوء الملون الذي يشع مثل طاقة النبض مما يمنحك تجربة لعب غامرة مع الأناقة!            منافذ IO   DC-in HDMI™ 2.1(4K@60Hz) USB 3.2 Gen2 Type-A USB 3.2 Gen2 Type-C / DisplayPort™ / Power Delivery 3.0 مقبس صوت كومبو USB 3.2 Gen2 Type-A RJ45 قفل Kensington  *يدعم الشحن PD بقدرة 100W (20V@5A) عند تشغيل النظام (S0 Power State) ووضع السكون (Modern Standby Low-Power Idle State)، و 45W(20V@2.25A) وحتى 100W(20V@5A) في وضع Hibernate (S4 Power State)، ووضع الإيقاف (S5 Power State). قد يتأثر أداء النظام الإجمالي للتكيف مع تيار الشحن. سيختلف معدل الشحن اعتمادًا على النظام وحالة البطارية. يُوصى باستخدام شاحن MSI PD.

products.raw_description:
ASUS ZENBOOK DUO
Let’s DUO It
The next generation of mobile multitasking. ASUS Zenbook DUO combines two professional 14-inch 3K OLED touchscreens, powerful Intel Core Ultra performance and a detachable Bluetooth keyboard in one compact device.




      

TWO SCREENS. ONE DEVICE.
Your Dual-Monitor Workspace, Anywhere
Use it as a traditional laptop or expand your workspace across two full-size displays for productivity, content creation, communication and entertainment.






COMPACT SIZE. ENDURING BUILD.
The Most Compact Zenbook DUO Yet
A redesigned hideaway hinge reduces the gap between both displays by 70%, creating a cleaner and more immersive dual-screen experience in a footprint that is 5% smaller than the previous generation.





THE MOST POWERFUL DUO
Intel Core Ultra X9 Performance
The Intel Core Ultra X9 378H processor combines a 16-core CPU, Intel Arc graphics and a 50 TOPS Intel NPU for advanced AI, multitasking, 4K video editing, creative work and gaming.





IMMERSIVE DUAL SCREENS
Nearly 20 Inches of Expansive Viewing
Enjoy an extended desktop across two 14-inch ASUS Lumina Pro OLED touchscreens. Work, create, communicate and manage several applications without carrying a separate monitor.





      

SEAMLESS MULTITASKING
Two Displays, Fully Integrated
The integrated kickstand, detachable keyboard and intelligent software provide a familiar dual-monitor experience that remains portable, flexible and easy to set up.






ASUS LUMINA PRO OLED
Dual 3K OLED. 144Hz. Touch.
Both 14-inch OLED touch displays deliver 2880 × 1800 resolution, a smooth 144Hz refresh rate, 0.2ms response time, 100% DCI-P3 color coverage and up to 1000 nits HDR peak brightness.




DUAL RESOLUTION 2880 × 1800


REFRESH RATE 144Hz


HDR BRIGHTNESS Up to 1000 Nits


COLOR GAMUT 100% DCI-P3


RESPONSE TIME 0.2ms


DISPLAY TYPE OLED Touch






ASUS CERALUMINUM
30% Lighter. Three Times Stronger.
The premium Ceraluminum chassis combines the light weight of aluminum with ceramic-like strength, scratch resistance and a durable textured finish in the distinctive Moher Gray color.






WORK. GAME. CREATE.
Performance Without the Desktop
Intel Arc graphics accelerate content creation, 3D applications, video editing and modern gaming. The improved cooling system supports up to 45W performance using large 97-blade fans and expanded airflow.






99WH DUAL-BATTERY SYSTEM
Made for All-Day Mobility
The balanced dual-battery design delivers up to 18 hours of local video playback with both screens enabled. Fast charging reaches approximately 60% capacity in 49 minutes under ASUS test conditions.






FULL CONNECTIVITY
All the Ports You Need
Two Thunderbolt 4 ports support charging, high-speed data and external displays. HDMI 2.1, USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-A and an audio combo jack complete the connectivity package.






SMART VERSATILITY
One Device. Multiple Modes.
Switch effortlessly between Laptop Mode, Dual Screen Mode, Desktop Mode and Sharing Mode. Smart gestures let you summon the virtual keyboard, maximize windows across both screens and assign applications to your preferred display.

products.raw_description:
PROART × GOPRO EDITION

    Be the Hero of Your Story

    
      Built for creators who capture and edit on the move. The ASUS ProArt
      GoPro Edition PX13 combines extreme AMD Ryzen AI performance, 128GB
      unified memory, a professional 3K Lumina OLED touchscreen and a rugged
      360° convertible design.
    
  

  
  
    
      

    
      PERFORMANCE IN MOTION

      Power for Serious Creative Work

      
        AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395, Radeon 8060S graphics and 128GB of unified
        LPDDR5X memory deliver the performance needed for multi-layer 4K and
        8K editing, RAW photo processing, AI workloads and 3D creation.
      
    
  

  
  
    

    
      GEAR UP LIKE A HERO

      GoPro-Inspired Design

      
        A rugged black-metal finish, exclusive CNC detailing, cyan accents and
        a matching GoPro-inspired sleeve make the PX13 ready for creators who
        shoot and edit wherever the adventure takes them.
      
    
  

  
  
    

    
      AI POWER. NO SLOWDOWNS.

      AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395

      
        Experience 16 cores, 32 threads, speeds up to 5.1GHz and an AMD XDNA
        NPU delivering up to 50 TOPS for AI-assisted editing, transcription,
        scene detection, image enhancement and demanding creative applications.
      
    
  

  
  
    

    
      STREAMLINED CREATIVE WORKFLOW

      Capture. Transfer. Organize. Edit.

      
        The dedicated GoPro Hotkey launches GoPro Player instantly, while
        StoryCube integration helps import, preview, categorize and search
        your GoPro footage using time, location, activity, text or images.
      
    
  

  
  
    

    
      TRUE-TO-LIFE OLED DISPLAY

      Every Frame. Ultra Clear. Ultra Real.

      
        The 13.3-inch 3K ASUS Lumina OLED touchscreen delivers 2880 × 1800
        resolution, 100% DCI-P3 coverage, Delta E < 1 accuracy, true blacks
        and stylus support with up to 4096 pressure levels.
      
    
  

  
  
    

    
      READY FOR ADVENTURE

      Rugged 360° Convertible Design

      
        Switch between laptop, tablet, stand and tent modes using the flexible
        360° hinge. Weighing only 1.39kg and tested to the MIL-STD 810H
        military-grade standard, it is designed to create anywhere.
      
    
  

  
  
    DYNAMIC UNIFIED MEMORY

    128GB Built for Heavy Lifts

    
      Ultra-fast LPDDR5X 8000MHz unified memory gives the processor and Radeon
      graphics access to one large memory pool. Supported workloads can allocate
      up to 96GB as dedicated variable graphics memory, helping remove traditional
      bottlenecks in AI, 3D rendering and high-resolution editing.

products.raw_description:
Some laptops play games. The Legion 5 15IAX10 lives them. Under its Eclipse Black lid sits an Intel® Core™ Ultra 7 255HX with 20 cores pushing up to 5.2GHz, paired with NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 5060 graphics, and both feed a 15.1" WQXGA OLED screen that renders your world in deep, true color at 165Hz. From the first raid to the last ranked match of the night, this is the machine that keeps up with you.

Uncompromising Performance
The Intel® Core™ Ultra 7 255HX combines 8 Performance-cores and 12 Efficient-cores for 20 cores / 20 threads of raw processing power, boosting to 5.2GHz with 30MB of Intel® Smart Cache. A dedicated Lenovo LA3 AI chip plus an Intel® AI Boost NPU (up to 13 TOPS) tune performance, thermals and battery life in real time, so the Legion stays fast and cool exactly when it matters.

GeForce RTX™ 5060. Built for the Win.
The NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 5060 Laptop GPU with 8GB GDDR7 runs at a full 115W TGP and boosts to 2497MHz, delivering 572 AI TOPS for next-level AI performance. Enjoy realistic ray tracing, NVIDIA DLSS frame boosting, and the headroom to stream, create and compete on the same machine.

A Display You Can Feel
The 15.1" WQXGA (2560×1600) OLED panel hits 1000 nits peak brightness, covers 100% DCI-P3, and is certified DisplayHDR™ True Black 600 with Dolby Vision®. Blacks are truly black, colors pop, and every frame arrives at a silky 165Hz. Once you play on OLED, going back is not an option.

Built Around You
A 24-zone RGB backlit Arabic keyboard lights up your setup, HARMAN stereo speakers with Nahimic Audio put you in the middle of the action, and the 80Wh battery with a 245W Slim Tip adapter keeps the fight going. On top, an aluminum lid, Eclipse Black finish, and a 5.0MP camera with e-shutter complete a laptop that looks as sharp as it plays, starting at just 1.9 kg.

Connect Everything
One Thunderbolt™ 4 port, USB-C with 100W Power Delivery and DisplayPort 2.1, three USB-A ports (one Always On), HDMI 2.1 up to 8K/60Hz, and Gigabit Ethernet mean external monitors, peripherals and fast internet are always one cable away. Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth® 5.4 handle the wireless side.

Key Features

  Intel® Core™ Ultra 7 255HX: 20C (8P + 12E) / 20T, up to 5.2GHz, 30MB Smart Cache
  NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 5060 8GB GDDR7, 115W TGP, 572 AI TOPS
  Lenovo LA3 AI chip + Intel® AI Boost NPU (up to 13 TOPS)
  15.1" WQXGA (2560×1600) OLED, 165Hz, 1000 nits peak, 100% DCI-P3
  DisplayHDR™ True Black 600 and Dolby Vision® support
  32GB (2× 16GB) DDR5-5600 dual-channel memory
  1TB M.2 2242 PCIe 4.0×4 NVMe SSD, second M.2 2280 slot free
  24-zone RGB backlit Arabic keyboard
  Thunderbolt™ 4, USB-C 100W PD with DP 2.1, 3× USB-A, HDMI 2.1
  Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be) 2×2 + Bluetooth® 5.4
  80Wh battery with 245W Slim Tip fast adapter
  Aluminum top / Eclipse Black finish, starting at 1.9 kg
  5.0MP camera with e-shutter for privacy

    مستند



    
        
                            
    
        
            
                
                    
    

    
        وُلد للأداء
        مُصمم لمحترفي STEM، يقدم Vector 17 HX AI أداءً متطوراً واستقراراً راسخاً. إنه يعمل كعقل عالي التقنية، يعالج البيانات المعقدة بسلاسة مع السرعة والدقة. من تطوير البرمجيات إلى تحليل البيانات والمحاكاة، يوفر Vector 17 HX AI الأداء والموثوقية التي يحتاجها المهندسون للنجاح.
    


                            
    
        
            
                    
        
            أداء بقوة الحاسوب المكتبي مع كفاءة. حتى معالج Intel® Core™ Ultra 9 275HX
            
                يفتح مستوى جديداً من الأداء مع بنية P-core و E-core الجديدة كلياً التي تقدم أداءً محسناً لكل واط، معالج Intel® Core™ Ultra 9 275HX هنا ليجعل الألعاب المحمولة أكثر برودة وهدوءاً مع أداء من فئة النخبة.
*الأداء والطاقة مقارنة بالجيل السابق من معالج Intel® Core™ i9 14900HX. قد تختلف النتائج حسب السيناريو.

حتى أكثر من 20% تعزيز في الأداء*

24 نواة (8 أنوية P-Cores + 16 نواة E-Cores)

وحدة معالجة عصبية NPU بالداخل


            
        
    


    
        
            
                    
        
            وحدات معالجة الرسوميات GeForce RTX 50 Series للحواسب المحمولة. تغيير جذري في اللعبة.
            
                مدعومة بمعمارية NVIDIA Blackwell، تجلب وحدات معالجة الرسوميات GeForce RTX™ 50 Series للحواسب المحمولة قدرات تغير قواعد اللعبة للاعبين والمبدعين. مزودة بمستوى هائل من قوة الذكاء الاصطناعي، تتيح سلسلة RTX 50 تجارب جديدة ومستوى جديد من دقة الرسوميات. ضاعف الأداء مع NVIDIA DLSS 4، وولّد الصور بسرعة غير مسبوقة، وأطلق العنان لإبداعك مع NVIDIA Studio. كل ذلك في أنحف حواسب RTX محمولة وأطولها عمراً، محسّنة بتقنية Max-Q.

            
        
    


    
        
            
                    
        
            سرعة فائقة. مرئيات استثنائية. مدعومة بالذكاء الاصطناعي.
            
                NVIDIA DLSS هي مجموعة ثورية من تقنيات الـ neural rendering التي تستخدم الذكاء الاصطناعي لزيادة FPS وتقليل زمن الاستجابة وتحسين جودة الصورة. يقدم DLSS 4 ميزة Multi Frame Generation الجديدة وتحسينات Ray Reconstruction و Super Resolution، مدعومة بوحدات معالجة الرسوميات GeForce RTX 50 Series والجيل الخامس من أنوية Tensor.

            
        
    


    
        
            
                        
                    
        
            تقنية MSI OverBoost Ultra
            
                عندما تتطلب أعباء العمل القصوى موارد CPU و GPU كاملة، تقدم تقنية MSI OverBoost Ultra أداءً مشتركاً أقصى مع خرج طاقة إجمالي يبلغ 250W.
*250W بناءً على تكوين معالج Intel® Core™ Ultra 9 275HX مع وحدة معالجة رسوميات NVIDIA® GeForce RTX™ 5080 Laptop GPU وما فوق.
*ضمن وضع الأداء الأقصى بواسطة MSI Center مع طاقة التيار المتردد.
*قد يختلف حسب السيناريو.

            
        
    

                            
    
        
            
                    
        
            حل تبريد مبتكر
            
                مصمم للكمال، يقدم أحدث تصميم Cooler Boost 5 حلولاً حرارية مخصصة لكل من CPU و GPU. مع مراوح أكبر وأنابيب حرارية أوسع، يضمن أداءً مثالياً حتى خلال جلسات الألعاب الأكثر كثافة.


2 مروحة

6 أنابيب حرارية
تصميم الأنابيب المشتركة بين CPU و GPU

                مع دعم يصل إلى قرصين SSD، وسرعات نقل فائقة، وذاكرة تصل إلى DDR5-6400MHz، تقدم سلسلة Vector أداء بيانات متطرفاً وقدرة لا مثيل لها في الألعاب وتعدد المهام. استمتع بأعلى كفاءة لجميع مهام العمل الخاصة بك.

                حواسب MSI المحمولة المخصصة للألعاب مصممة خصيصاً للاعبين بدقة عالية ومعدل تحديث مرتفع. اجعل عالم ألعابك أكثر واقعية وسلاسة من أي وقت مضى.
*اختياري. المواصفات الفعلية قد تختلف حسب التكوينات.

source_table.TWO FULL-SIZE 16-INCH DISPLAYS:
The Zephyrus Duo combines two full-size 16:10 OLED panels in one mobile chassis,
        giving you a true multi-display workspace wherever you go.
Dual Screen, Laptop, Sharing, Book and Tent modes let the Zephyrus Duo adapt
        to gaming, coding, presenting, multitasking and creative workflows.
Built for demanding gaming, AI workloads, 3D rendering and professional content creation.
        The RTX 5090 Laptop GPU can run at up to 150W Max TGP, paired with the Intel Core Ultra 9 386H.
source_table.POWER FOR EVERYTHING:
The Intel Core Ultra 9 386H features 16 cores and 16 threads, with an integrated
          NPU delivering up to 50 TOPS for local AI acceleration and Copilot+ PC features.
source_table.64GB LPDDR5X-8533:
Ultra-fast LPDDR5X memory gives the Zephyrus Duo workstation-class multitasking capability
          for gaming, editing, large creative projects and professional applications.
source_table.2TB PCIe 5.0 NVMe SSD:
High-speed PCIe 5.0 storage gives fast access to games, applications and large creative files.
          A second M.2 slot is available for expansion.
Both 16-inch OLED touch displays deliver 2880 × 1800 resolution, 120Hz refresh rate,
        0.2ms response time, rich HDR contrast and professional-grade color.
source_table.KEEP THE POWER UNDER CONTROL:
A custom vapor chamber, dual fans, liquid metal and graphite nano-insulated film
        work together to manage heat inside this ultra-complex dual-screen chassis.
source_table.DISTINCTLY ZEPHYRUS:
CNC-machined aluminum construction and the signature Zephyrus design language
        give the Duo a premium finish without losing its unmistakable gaming identity.
The magnetic wireless keyboard gives the Duo its flexibility:
          use it attached like a traditional laptop, move it away for a full dual-screen workspace,
          or position it wherever your setup demands.
source_table.SIX-SPEAKER SOUND:
A six-speaker system with Smart Amp technology and Dolby Atmos delivers
          spacious sound for games, movies and music.
source_table.90WH BATTERY:
A 90Wh battery powers the Duo on the move, while USB-C charging support
          up to 100W gives you a lighter charging option when full gaming power is not required.
source_table.READY FOR A FULL DESKTOP SETUP:
High-speed Thunderbolt 4, HDMI 2.1, USB-A, UHS-II SD card reader and wireless connectivity
        make the Zephyrus Duo ready for monitors, storage, docks and professional peripherals.

source_table.Let’s DUO It: The next generation of mobile multitasking. ASUS Zenbook DUO combines two professional 14-inch 3K OLED touchscreens, powerful Intel Core Ultra performance and a detachable Bluetooth keyboard in one compact device.
source_table.Your Dual-Monitor Workspace, Anywhere: Use it as a traditional laptop or expand your workspace across two full-size displays for productivity, content creation, communication and entertainment.
source_table.The Most Compact Zenbook DUO Yet: A redesigned hideaway hinge reduces the gap between both displays by 70%, creating a cleaner and more immersive dual-screen experience in a footprint that is 5% smaller than the previous generation.
source_table.Intel Core Ultra X9 Performance: The Intel Core Ultra X9 378H processor combines a 16-core CPU, Intel Arc graphics and a 50 TOPS Intel NPU for advanced AI, multitasking, 4K video editing, creative work and gaming.
source_table.Nearly 20 Inches of Expansive Viewing: Enjoy an extended desktop across two 14-inch ASUS Lumina Pro OLED touchscreens. Work, create, communicate and manage several applications without carrying a separate monitor.
source_table.Two Displays, Fully Integrated: The integrated kickstand, detachable keyboard and intelligent software provide a familiar dual-monitor experience that remains portable, flexible and easy to set up.
Both 14-inch OLED touch displays deliver 2880 × 1800 resolution, a smooth 144Hz refresh rate, 0.2ms response time, 100% DCI-P3 color coverage and up to 1000 nits HDR peak brightness.
The premium Ceraluminum chassis combines the light weight of aluminum with ceramic-like strength, scratch resistance and a durable textured finish in the distinctive Moher Gray color.
source_table.Performance Without the Desktop: Intel Arc graphics accelerate content creation, 3D applications, video editing and modern gaming. The improved cooling system supports up to 45W performance using large 97-blade fans and expanded airflow.
source_table.Made for All-Day Mobility: The balanced dual-battery design delivers up to 18 hours of local video playback with both screens enabled. Fast charging reaches approximately 60% capacity in 49 minutes under ASUS test conditions.
source_table.All the Ports You Need: Two Thunderbolt 4 ports support charging, high-speed data and external displays. HDMI 2.1, USB 3.2 Gen 2 Type-A and an audio combo jack complete the connectivity package.
Switch effortlessly between Laptop Mode, Dual Screen Mode, Desktop Mode and Sharing Mode. Smart gestures let you summon the virtual keyboard, maximize windows across both screens and assign applications to your preferred display.

source_table.Be the Hero of Your Story:
Built for creators who capture and edit on the move. The ASUS ProArt
      GoPro Edition PX13 combines extreme AMD Ryzen AI performance, 128GB
      unified memory, a professional 3K Lumina OLED touchscreen and a rugged
      360° convertible design.
source_table.Power for Serious Creative Work:
AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395, Radeon 8060S graphics and 128GB of unified
        LPDDR5X memory deliver the performance needed for multi-layer 4K and
        8K editing, RAW photo processing, AI workloads and 3D creation.
source_table.GoPro-Inspired Design:
A rugged black-metal finish, exclusive CNC detailing, cyan accents and
        a matching GoPro-inspired sleeve make the PX13 ready for creators who
        shoot and edit wherever the adventure takes them.
source_table.AMD Ryzen AI MAX+ 395:
Experience 16 cores, 32 threads, speeds up to 5.1GHz and an AMD XDNA
        NPU delivering up to 50 TOPS for AI-assisted editing, transcription,
        scene detection, image enhancement and demanding creative applications.
The dedicated GoPro Hotkey launches GoPro Player instantly, while
        StoryCube integration helps import, preview, categorize and search
        your GoPro footage using time, location, activity, text or images.
The 13.3-inch 3K ASUS Lumina OLED touchscreen delivers 2880 × 1800
        resolution, 100% DCI-P3 coverage, Delta E < 1 accuracy, true blacks
        and stylus support with up to 4096 pressure levels.
source_table.Rugged 360° Convertible Design:
Switch between laptop, tablet, stand and tent modes using the flexible
        360° hinge. Weighing only 1.39kg and tested to the MIL-STD 810H
        military-grade standard, it is designed to create anywhere.
source_table.128GB Built for Heavy Lifts:
Ultra-fast LPDDR5X 8000MHz unified memory gives the processor and Radeon
      graphics access to one large memory pool. Supported workloads can allocate
      up to 96GB as dedicated variable graphics memory, helping remove traditional
      bottlenecks in AI, 3D rendering and high-resolution editing.
